description.value: The Guildford Branch is one of ten public library branches operated by Surrey Libraries across Surrey, BC. It is a two-storey facility and is one of only three branches in the system equipped with assistive technology stations, including screen-reading and magnification software. As a free public space, it offers a welcoming stop for cyclists in the Guildford neighbourhood.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is the Surrey Libraries system-wide homepage and does not provide Guildford-branch-specific amenity details (no bike parking, washrooms, or water refill mentioned). OSM confirms internet_access=wlan and wheelchair=yes, and the Accessibility Services subpage explicitly names 'Guildford' as one of three branches with assistive technology stations, confirming the branch is active. No cycling-specific amenities are evidenced on the website or in OSM tags beyond general public-library expectations.
concerns: Website is system-wide (surreylibraries.ca) with no branch-specific amenity or contact details for Guildford; the OSM phone number (+1-604-598-7360) could not be corroborated against a Guildford-specific listing on the website.
OSM internet_access=wlan tag not independently confirmed via website content — website does not explicitly mention in-branch Wi-Fi for visitors.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The Guildford Branch is a confirmed, active public library that could serve as a useful cyclist stop, but none of the three required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from the available evidence. A branch-specific page or site visit would be needed to verify cyclist-relevant amenities before including.
